name: Legacy Raised-Floor DC
cooling_architecture: perimeter CRAC/CRAH; raised-floor plenum; chilled water or DX; no containment
key_equipment: perimeter CRAC; raised-floor tiles; legacy PDU breakers; flooded VRLA UPS; FM-200 panels; legacy DDC
notes: Often Tier II equivalent; high PUE; many parts now NRND/obsolete.

name: Enterprise Tier III
cooling_architecture: in-row or perimeter cooling; hot-aisle containment; chilled water; concurrently maintainable
key_equipment: static UPS modules; MV/LV switchgear; ATS/STS; diesel gensets; air-cooled or water-cooled chillers; CRAH; BMS DDC; VESDA
notes: Uptime Tier III; the bulk of enterprise/colo DC stock.

name: Colocation / Wholesale DC
cooling_architecture: in-row + hot-aisle containment; water-cooled chillers + economizer; some rear-door HX
key_equipment: modular UPS galleries; medium-voltage switchgear; busway; large chiller plants; cooling towers; STS for dual-cord; FACP
notes: Multi-tenant wholesale; standardized blocks; rapid build cadence.

name: Cloud Hyperscale Campus
cooling_architecture: free-cooling economizer; evaporative/adiabatic; rear-door HX; some direct-to-chip on AI rows
key_equipment: OEM/ODM UPS or DC-bus; 415V/400V busway; large air-handling units; dry coolers; adiabatic coolers; OEM BMS; clean-agent
notes: Lean, custom-engineered; tight supplier partnerships; long lead-time M&E.

name: AI Factory (Liquid-Cooled)
cooling_architecture: direct-to-chip liquid (CDU); rear-door HX; immersion (single/two-phase); facility water loop + dry coolers
key_equipment: CDU coolant distribution units; cold plates; cooling manifolds; dielectric coolant filters; 415V busway taps for 100kW+ racks; high-density UPS or DC-bus; large dry coolers; leak detection
notes: Highest rack density; emerging supply chain; many specialist OEMs; liquid-cooling parts are the new critical class.

name: Edge / Micro-DC
cooling_architecture: self-contained in-rack cooling; DX or chilled water; sealed enclosure
key_equipment: in-rack cooling units; small UPS; mini PDU; environmental sensors; remote monitoring; small fire suppression
notes: Distributed micro-facilities; remote management; consumable-heavy maintenance.
